A '''skeletal miner''' is an [[undead]] monster. It appears on the level 2 and 4 of the [[Abandoned Mine]] as a '''corpse''' and will animate occasionally when walked past to attack you. They count as [[Skeletons (Slayer assignment)|skeletons]] for the purpose of [[Slayer assignment]].
